page.content:
Weyland android whose experiments seed later horrors.

How David connects

  • Work: Prometheus — David is the android center of Prometheus.
  • Work: Alien: Covenant — Covenant turns on David's xenomorph experiments.
  • Faction: Weyland-Yutani — David is Weyland's android on the Prometheus mission.
  • Concept: Xenomorph — David's Covenant experiments refine creatures toward the xenomorph.

What is David?

David is the Prometheus android who studies the pathogen and, by Covenant, treats xenomorph design as his own art.

Key threads lead to Prometheus, Alien: Covenant, Weyland-Yutani and Xenomorph.
